frontmatter.description: Use for the CopilotKit CLI — `npx copilotkit@latest`. Covers proving a project's wiring with `verify` before debugging anything by hand, scaffolding with `create`, signing in and selecting a hosted Intelligence project, agent-assisted onboarding of an existing app, generating type-safe agent ids, and importing thread history. Reach for `verify` first whenever a CopilotKit app is not working.
